_doc: Recorded per-module wall seconds (one module per process, Windows host Python 3.12, founder laptop, 2026-11-07 closeout) used by scripts/run_tests.py to build chunks under the 900 s budget. test_hardware_gate (RTL simulations with iverilog/vvp) hit the 900 s timeout in the closeout run and is therefore NOT measured; 1750 s is INFERRED from the Phase 1.1 full-suite total (1863 s) minus the other modules, so the runner refuses it without --approved. Modules not listed default to 120 s.
